descriptions.text: Hell-Kissed Celestial Skill Potion of the Prince of Woe. In case you haven’t figured this out yet, we’re trying to kick things up a notch this year. If we’re gonna do this, we want all of you fuckers as deadly as possible. Hence, this prize. It’s time to bring out your inner demon. Drinking this potion will give you a random level 10 to 15 Celestial-tier skill. The skill will be combat based, and it will be something you don’t already have. This skill potion is hell-kissed. That means this skill will be any combat-based skill from any Sheol-level mob level 200 or higher. Go ahead and drink it. Do it. Do it.

beats.headline: Out of a drum kit
beats.text: The Celestial Heavy Metal box arrives as a full drum kit with pyrotechnics, Amayon's face on both bass drums and an ethereal demon playing speed metal behind it. Mongo screeches. The kit explodes, 666 hangs in the air in smoke, and all that is left is one glittering potion in a horned-skull bottle with a note tied round the top: Drink Me, and a demon hand giving the devil horns. The liquid is black and bubbling. Mordecai, shaking, calls it a Celestial-quality skill potion, and once Carl has examined it he rushes it off to his table. He comes back whispering that he could make these, with a few more table upgrades and some pretty specialized ingredients.

beats.headline: Drink me deep
beats.text: Mordecai tells Carl to take it right away, since whatever it gives him he will need to train with. The bottle speaks up in a deep, demonic voice: drink me, drink me deep. Carl pops the cork and drinks it manually, which is a mistake, because it tastes like ass. The potion groans as it dissipates into dust. For a fraction of a second he sees the burning hellscape of Sheol, smells the sulfur and feels worms crawling over him. A demon-skull button appears in his interface: the level-13 Gloom Wraith Phase, a non-corporeal lunge that passes through unenchanted weapons and flesh and scrambles any living thing unarmored against non-corporeal attacks.
